response.sql:
WITH channel_rates AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), above_average AS (
  SELECT orderbase, avg_feerate
  FROM channel_rates
  WHERE avg_feerate > (SELECT AVG(feerate) FROM fees WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_average_fee_rate,
       AVG(avg_feerate - (SELECT AVG(feerate) FROM fees WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL)) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: “Overall average” is the unweighted average of all non-null fee records tied to an order; each qualifying channel’s mean is then weighted equally in the requested across-channel averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare channel averages with the unweighted average of channel averages, then average the qualifying channels’ excess over that benchmark.
alternatives.sql:
WITH channel_rates AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM channel_rates
), above_average AS (
  SELECT c.avg_feerate
  FROM channel_rates AS c
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE c.avg_feerate > b.avg_feerate
)
SELECT AVG(a.avg_feerate) AS mean_average_fee_rate,
       AVG(a.avg_feerate - b.avg_feerate) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average AS a
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
